scripts.workbench: npm run workbench:blade && npm run workbench:vue
scripts.workbench:blade: vendor/bin/phpunit --no-configuration --bootstrap vendor/autoload.php workbench/WorkbenchTest.php && tailwindcss -i workbench/app.css -o build/workbench/app.css --minify
scripts.workbench:vue: tailwindcss -i workbench/vue/app.css -o build/vue-tokens.css --minify && vite build --config workbench/vue/vite.config.mjs
